limitations: The points are representative visible fairway-entry navigation references, not published/surveyed Orange GPS or verified daily markers.
The club guide establishes site identity; native imagery establishes a visible mown support area. No fitted schematic-to-world registration or scorecard-distance interpolation is used.
Interpretation bounds are manual site-identification allowances, not statistical accuracy estimates.
Evidence support rings must never be promoted to physical pad geometry or runtime course surfaces.
2025-06-14 native imagery does not establish changes made after capture.
